item.title: LENT MOMENT: Fr. Sserumaga offers guidance for the final days of Lent - NTV Uganda
item.description: At the beginning of the Lenten season, many Christians pledged to abide by the pillars of Lent, but midway through, many have still fallen short of their promises. Today, Rev. Fr. John Bosco Sserumaga, the National Editorial Director of Radio Maria Uganda, explains what you should do in the remaining days of Lent.

item.title: 2026 National Rally flags off in Eastern Uganda this Friday - NTV Uganda
item.description: Once again, engines are set to rumble as the 2026 national rally calendar officially flags off in Eastern Uganda. The three-day event gets underway this Friday with a super special stage at Maruku Stadium in Mbale City, before traversing Budaka and Bukedea districts on Saturday and Sunday.

item.title: Over 600 boxers compete in National Intermediate Championships - NTV Uganda
item.description: Over 600 boxers are facing off in three categories in this year’s National Intermediate Boxing Championships, which began last evening at TLC Grounds in Kamwokya. The young pugilists are aiming to upgrade to national boxing champions and stand a chance to join the national boxing team, the Bombers.
